maya: FYI onboarding hf/edu-summarizer-v2 — runtime picked the slow tokenizer even though model artifact contains tokenizer.json (fast) and tokenizer_config.json (slow). chat template tokens missing, generation truncates. stack: 
maya: 
```
maya@runner:/models/edu-summarizer-v2$ cat loader.log | tail -n 20
I 08:12:31 Loader: found tokenizer.json -> type=fast
W 08:12:31 FastTokenizer: missing file merges.txt
I 08:12:31 Falling back to slow tokenizer loader: using tokenizer_config.json
E 08:12:31 ChatTemplate: missing special token <|sep|>
```
maya: model works in HF locally, fails in Redwood runtime. :confused:

jon: uh. can you paste ls -la of the model dir and both jsons?

maya:
```
maya@runner:/models/edu-summarizer-v2$ ls -la
total 88
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  2387 Mar  2 tokenizer.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  1345 Mar  2 tokenizer_config.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  4550 Mar  2 vocab.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  1223 Mar  2 special_tokens_map.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  0    Mar  2 merges.txt
```
maya: note merges.txt is empty (was only for BPE fast) and special_tokens_map.json exists.

li: sounds like two issues: 1) loader heuristics: it sees tokenizer.json and assumes fast tokenizer but still expects merges.txt/merges, and 2) tokenizer_config.json contains authoritative special tokens for the HF slow tokenizer. Our loader currently stops after deciding fast vs slow and doesn't merge fields from tokenizer_config.json.

sam: quick temp workaround: create a minimal merges placeholder and copy special tokens into tokenizer.json, or symlink tokenizer_config.json -> tokenizer.json.specials. example script: 
```
# quick-fix.sh
cp tokenizer_config.json tokcfg.backup.json
jq '.special_tokens = (.special_tokens // .added_tokens // {})' tokenizer_config.json > specials.json
jq '. + {"special_tokens": (input_filename: "specials.json" | fromjson)}' tokenizer.json > tokenizer.json.fixed
mv tokenizer.json.fixed tokenizer.json
```
sam: (handwavey but worked for me locally) :white_check_mark:

li: long term we should: 
- make the loader read both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json and coalesce fields (prefer explicit fast artifacts but fill missing specials from tokenizer_config.json)
- if tokenizer.json exists but required binary files are absent (empty merges, no fast tokenizer binary), fallback gracefully and log one note rather than mis-classify

maya: I put a small repro + failing test in a branch: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/tokenloader/branches/hf-sideload-tokenmerge-2026 (linked PR incoming)

deploy-bot: CI run for PR #4123 passed: all unit tests + integration tokenloader smoke tests :white_check_mark: (build 8421)

jon: nice. can we also add a step to model onboarding checklist: verify both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json parity, and ensure merges.txt non-empty if expecting fast?

li: yes I'll send a PR to onboarding docs and the loader change. plan: 1) coalesce config, 2) add explicit warnings when fast artifacts incomplete, 3) unit test with HF export cases (fast-only, slow-only, both but mismatched).

maya: tested the patched loader on staging — generation matches HF baseline on our eval set (ROUGE/bertscore within noise). marking this as resolved for the immediate onboarding. thanks team. :tada:

jon: filing followup ticket to update eval harness to detect tokenizer mismatches automatically.

maya: assigning to @li for the loader patch + doc PR.
